http_api_unreachable.description: Root-cause abduction when HTTP/API probes fail (e.g. curl exit 7 connection refused, exit 28 timeout, or no route).

l3_missing_route_or_subnet_isolation.description: Missing Layer-3 route, wrong source interface, or unconfigured local IP in target subnet.
l3_missing_route_or_subnet_isolation.remediation: Check `ip -4 addr` and `ip route get <target_ip>`; add interface alias or static route.

service_on_nonstandard_port_or_tls.description: Target host is alive at L2/L3, but API listens on a non-standard port (e.g. 8443, 8000, 5000, 9000) or requires TLS.
service_on_nonstandard_port_or_tls.remediation: Run fast port discovery (`nc -zv` or `nmap -F -sT`) against the target IP.

l2_arp_incomplete_or_vlan_mismatch.description: Physical link or VLAN mismatch prevents Layer-2 ARP resolution (`FAILED` or `INCOMPLETE` in `ip neigh`).
l2_arp_incomplete_or_vlan_mismatch.remediation: Inspect `ip neigh show`, `ip -d link`, and switch/serial console VLAN assignments.

host_firewall_or_acl_reject.description: Target firewall (iptables/nftables) actively sends TCP RST (curl exit 7) or drops packets from non-management IPs.
host_firewall_or_acl_reject.remediation: Inspect target firewall rules via out-of-band serial console (`/dev/ttyUSB0`) or probe from allowed management IP.

api_daemon_stopped_or_bound_loopback.description: API service on the target has crashed or is bound solely to `127.0.0.1` instead of `0.0.0.0`.
api_daemon_stopped_or_bound_loopback.remediation: Access target via serial console (`/dev/ttyUSB0` with `tio`) and check `ss -tulpn` / `systemctl`.

curl_exit_7_Immediate_refused.description: curl returns exit code 7 immediately (<100ms TCP RST) or 'No route to host'

curl_exit_28_timeout.description: curl times out (exit code 28) with no TCP RST

arp_resolved_mac_present.description: Target IP resolves to a valid MAC address (`REACHABLE`/`STALE`) in `ip neigh`

icmp_ping_responds.description: Target responds to ICMP echo requests (`ping` 0% packet loss)

alt_port_open_in_scan.description: An alternate TCP port (e.g. 443, 5000, 8000, 8080, 8443) is OPEN on target

serial_ss_shows_127_0_0_1_only.probe_cmd: tio -b 115200 --mute --script-run once --script 'write("ss -tulpn\r"); while read(4096, 500) > 0 do end; exit(0)' /dev/ttyUSB0
serial_ss_shows_127_0_0_1_only.description: Serial console `ss -tulpn` shows service listening on 127.0.0.1 or not running

icmp_ping_fails.description: ICMP echo request times out (100% packet loss)

arp_incomplete_or_missing.description: ARP table entry for target IP is INCOMPLETE, FAILED, or missing

http_401_or_403_or_tls_alert.description: Target responds with HTTP 401/403 or TLS/mTLS handshake alert

target_outside_local_24_cidr.description: Target IP lies outside all directly attached local interface subnets

l2_l3_routing_blackhole.description: Root-cause abduction when routing Layer-2/Layer-3 traffic across disjoint subnets fails.

ip_forwarding_disabled_on_pivot.description: Pivot/gateway host has `net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0`, dropping transit packets between interfaces.
ip_forwarding_disabled_on_pivot.remediation: Enable `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` (Linux) or `Set-NetIPInterface -Forwarding Enabled` (Windows) on the transit/pivot node.

asymmetric_missing_return_route_or_nat.description: Packets reach destination ({remote_ip}), but destination lacks a return route to source subnet and needs MASQUERADE/SNAT.
asymmetric_missing_return_route_or_nat.remediation: Add return static route on destination OR enable `iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o {iface} -j MASQUERADE` on pivot.

firewall_forward_chain_drop.description: `iptables`/`nftables` FORWARD chain policy is DROP or rejects cross-interface traffic.
firewall_forward_chain_drop.remediation: Run `iptables -I FORWARD -j ACCEPT` or allow transit subnets in `nftables` / `netsh advfirewall`.

local_missing_static_route_via_gateway.description: Local workstation routes destination subnet out default gateway instead of the lab pivot IP.
local_missing_static_route_via_gateway.remediation: Run `sudo ip route replace {remote_subnet} via {gateway_ip} dev {iface}` (Linux) or `route add` / `New-NetRoute` (Windows).

l2_bridge_or_proxy_arp_required.description: Destination expects Layer-2 adjacency / ARP broadcast on same VLAN segment (`proxy_arp` or L2 bridge needed).
l2_bridge_or_proxy_arp_required.remediation: Enable `sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.proxy_arp=1` or configure bridge / VLAN subinterface.

ip_route_get_uses_default_wan.description: `ip route get` sends traffic to default WAN gateway instead of lab interface

tcpdump_sees_syn_out_no_synack_back.description: Egress interface transmits SYN to destination, destination receives it, but return packet never arrives

icmp_host_prohibited_or_filtered.description: Transit router returns ICMP Admin Prohibited / Packet Filtered or FORWARD drop counters increment

api_auth_rejection.description: Root-cause abduction when an API endpoint responds with 401/403/405/400 during security testing.

missing_bearer_or_api_key_header.description: Endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `X-API-Key`, or custom header discovered in JS/firmware.
missing_bearer_or_api_key_header.remediation: Inspect JS bundles, OpenAPI `/swagger.json`, or local config files via serial console for token headers.

wrong_http_method_or_json_content_type.description: Endpoint requires `POST`/`PUT` with `Content-Type: application/json` instead of `GET` or form-urlencoded.
wrong_http_method_or_json_content_type.remediation: Send `OPTIONS -i` and retry with `-X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' `.

session_cookie_or_csrf_handshake_needed.description: Stateful session cookie + CSRF token from `/login` or `/api/auth` must precede API calls.
session_cookie_or_csrf_handshake_needed.remediation: Use `curl -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt` to capture initial CSRF/session cookie first.

local_oob_credential_seed_required.description: Credentials/tokens are dynamically generated on device filesystem (`/etc/`, `/var/`, `/tmp/`).
local_oob_credential_seed_required.remediation: Extract token or hash via serial console (`/dev/ttyUSB0`) or local config backup.

http_405_or_415_status.description: Response status is 405 Method Not Allowed or 415 Unsupported Media Type

xff_127_0_0_1_changes_status.description: Adding `X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1` changes HTTP status or response length
